title: Standardize benchmarking runtime images and GPU driver pins
creator: Priya Shah
description: Goal: make our benchmarking harness produce reproducible, comparable tokens/sec and latency (p95) numbers across CI, on-demand runners, and Dedicated hardware by pinning the GPU driver, CUDA toolkit, container images, and runner configurations. Current problem: small driver/CUDA mismatches and drifting base images cause 5–15% variance in tokens/sec and occasional p95 regressions that are hard to attribute. This ticket will: 1) define a canonical set of pinned stacks (driver + CUDA + cuDNN + base image) for common GPU families we support (A10/A100/H100), 2) add image tags and a lightweight compatibility matrix, 3) bake reproducible runner AMIs/VM images and GitHub Actions runners for benchmarking, 4) extend our perf CI to validate environment pins before accepting model/regression PRs, and 5) add automated alerts when baseline metrics deviate beyond the expected noise envelope. Trade-offs: pinning reduces drift but increases maintenance burden during hardware/driver upgrades; we will adopt a quarterly review cadence for pin updates and automate canary runs on new pins before promoting them. Artifacts: Confluence spec, infra PRs, sample runner AMIs, and a dashboard for baseline comparisons.
notes: We must ensure pinned images are signed and stored in our artifact registry (GCR/ECR) with immutable tags.
Prioritize A100 and H100 stacks used by Dedicated customers; A10 stack for hosted/CI runners.
Define performance delta thresholds per model family (e.g., 3% tokens/sec, 10% p95 for long-context workloads).
implementation_steps: Draft canonical stack matrix for A10/A100/H100 (driver, CUDA, cuDNN, OS image). See Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RUN/Benchmark+Runtime+Standards
Build reproducible container images with pinned libs and publish immutable tags to GCR: gcr.io/redwood/bench-runtime:<tag>
Create hardened benchmark AMIs/VM images (cloud-init + pre-pulled images) and document runner boot scripts
Add an infra integration test that asserts the runtime stack hash matches expected before running perf jobs
Instrument CI to capture tokens/sec and p95 with deterministic inputs and store results in the perf datastore
Add regression detector job that compares daily baselines and opens ENG tickets when thresholds exceeded
risks: Pinned stack may lag behind security fixes; need fast patch path and monthly security scanning.
Different driver/CUDA combos can produce subtle numeric differences in kernels; must validate model sampling consistency.
Increased storage for immutable images and AMIs—coordinate with infra budget owners.
